Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be called the claimant on this one, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pasadena, Texas. I'd just pulled into a spot near the back row, pretty
slowly.
Q: What happened next?
A: I was backing out to leave and I heard a horn. Then another car came around the end of the row and clipped the
rear quarter panel of my vehicle.
Q: Was your vehicle moving at the time of impact?
A: Yes, I was reversing at maybe walking speed. I stopped as soon as I felt the bump.
Q: Did the other driver stop?
A: Yes, they stopped and got out. We exchanged information right there.
Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?
A: Not right away. I felt fine for maybe twenty minutes, then my neck started to stiffen and a headache came on.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening, and I've been seeing a physical therapist since. They told me I have
whiplash.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?
A: Yes, I have neck pain, especially when I turn my head to the left, and some stiffness in my upper back.
Q: Have you missed any time from work?
A: I missed about four days, and I've been doing lighter duties since then.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the incident?
A: Only that I'm still going to physical therapy twice a week, and I'd like to get this resolved so I can get back to
normal.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thanks.
</page>
